title: Global Mangrove Watch
description: A Portolan mirror of the Global Mangrove Watch v4.1.12 timeseries of mangrove extent, 1985 to 2025 (Bunting et al., 2026). It holds annual global extent as cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs and as GeoParquet partitioned by year. It also has change against the 1985, 1990, 2000, and 2010 baselines, the union and intersection of all years, and per-country area statistics. Source: Zenodo record 21346457 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.21346457). License: CC BY 4.0.
